dialogues.jp:
生活の流れとともに、一日の感覚がまた変わっ
てきた。
dialogues.en: I already feel different about the passing days.
dialogues.text: I already feel different about the passing days.

dialogues.jp:
さくらと登校して、校門前で充電して、授業を
受けて、屋上でお弁当を食べて、帰って音夢の
様子を見ながらその日の話をする。
dialogues.en:
I go to school with Sakura, she gets charged before the
school gate, take classes, eat lunch on the rooftop, and we
talk about the day when we get home while I check Nemu's
health.
dialogues.text:
I go to school with Sakura, she gets charged before the
school gate, take classes, eat lunch on the rooftop, and we
talk about the day when we get home while I check Nemu's
health.

dialogues.jp:
だいたい、１日の流れがこう説明できるように
なり、自分でも納得がいくようになった。
dialogues.en: I accept the situation that this is how my days go.
dialogues.text: I accept the situation that this is how my days go.

dialogues.jp:
家での出来事が希薄になり、生活の大半を過ご
す学園のほうに意識が移ってきているのか。
dialogues.en:
I think I've started to focus more on things at school,
where I spend most of the day, than at home.
dialogues.text:
I think I've started to focus more on things at school,
where I spend most of the day, than at home.

dialogues.jp:
とはいえ、授業自体が面白いわけではないので、
どうにも視線はきれいな桜の見える窓を向いて
しまう。
dialogues.en:
It doesn't mean I'm into studying. I still stare out of the
window at the beautiful cherry blossoms.
dialogues.text:
It doesn't mean I'm into studying. I still stare out of the
window at the beautiful cherry blossoms.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あ、ところで５月に入ったらすぐテストがあ
　るけど、みんな体調には気をつけろよ〜」
dialogues.en:
"At the beginning of May, you'll have a test. Take care of
your health by then!"
dialogues.text:
"At the beginning of May, you'll have a test. Take care of
your health by then!"

dialogues.jp:
本日最後の授業になる物理に参加しているさく
ら｛・・／先生｝が、どこぞのドラマに影響を受けたのか
口調を変えている。
dialogues.en:
Sakura-sensei in the physics class as the last period speaks
in a different way, I guess she must be influenced by some
kind of drama.
dialogues.text:
Sakura-sensei in the physics class as the last period speaks
in a different way, I guess she must be influenced by some
kind of drama.

dialogues.speaker: Male student
dialogues.jp: 「おっす！」
dialogues.en: "Hey!"
dialogues.text: "Hey!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ちなみに、さくら先生はなんだか体育会系の
　男子と、文系の女子に異常な人気があるらし
　いぞ」
dialogues.en:
"You know what? Sakura-sensei is very popular, especially
among the guys on the varsity team and female arts
students."
dialogues.text:
"You know what? Sakura-sensei is very popular, especially
among the guys on the varsity team and female arts
students."

dialogues.jp: 軽く振り返って杉並が呟く。
dialogues.en: Suginami mutters, turning around.
dialogues.text: Suginami mutters, turning around.

dialogues.jp: 「マジか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you serious?"
dialogues.text: "Are you serious?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そのスジには、たまらないらしい。合言葉も
　あるらしいぞ」
dialogues.en:
"They're really into her, and they also have the password,
too."
dialogues.text:
"They're really into her, and they also have the password,
too."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんだそれ？」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「さくらたん萌え〜、と」
dialogues.en: "'Sweet Sakura Haha'."
dialogues.text: "'Sweet Sakura Haha'."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……それは……難儀だな」
dialogues.en: "It sounds weird."
dialogues.text: "It sounds weird."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ほ〜い。じゃあこの問題を市原さん」
dialogues.en: "Okay, Ichihara-san. Can you solve this problem?"
dialogues.text: "Okay, Ichihara-san. Can you solve this problem?"

dialogues.jp:
当の本人はそんなことは露知らず――まぁ、知っ
ていても別段問題なく授業をしている。
dialogues.en:
Sakura herself has no idea about what's going on. Well, even
if she knew, she wouldn't care less and would just keep
teaching the class as usual.
dialogues.text:
Sakura herself has no idea about what's going on. Well, even
if she knew, she wouldn't care less and would just keep
teaching the class as usual.

dialogues.speaker: Ichihara
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Ichihara
dialogues.jp: 「……平和だな」
dialogues.en: "What a peaceful day..."
dialogues.text: "What a peaceful day..."

dialogues.jp:
頬杖をついて、シャーペンを回しながらあくび
をかみ殺す。
dialogues.en:
I hide a yawn while resting my cheek in my hand, flicking a
mechanical pencil.
dialogues.text:
I hide a yawn while resting my cheek in my hand, flicking a
mechanical pencil.

dialogues.jp:
一時はさくらの異常さに騒然としていたクラス
もあったが、慣れてしまえば平凡な日常そのも
のである。
dialogues.en:
At first, everyone was agitated because Sakura was so
unusual, but now they're used to it, we have a smooth day as
usual.
dialogues.text:
At first, everyone was agitated because Sakura was so
unusual, but now they're used to it, we have a smooth day as
usual.

dialogues.jp:
他の先生のように敬語じゃなくてもいいし、年
齢が同じだから話題もよく合う。
dialogues.en:
We don't need to speak formally to her, and we have common
topics to talk about since we're the same age.
dialogues.text:
We don't need to speak formally to her, and we have common
topics to talk about since we're the same age.

dialogues.speaker: Ichihara
dialogues.jp: 「これで良いですか？」
dialogues.en: "Is this all right?"
dialogues.text: "Is this all right?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ＧＯＯＤ。じゃ次のところをおに――朝倉く
　ん」
dialogues.en: "Good. Then, the next one is for onii... Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Good. Then, the next one is for onii... Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はい……あれ？　次の問題なんてないぞ？」
dialogues.en: "Sure... huh? There are no more problems left."
dialogues.text: "Sure... huh? There are no more problems left."

dialogues.jp:
教科書の例題は、今の範囲だともう残っていな
い。
dialogues.en: There are no example problems left in the textbook.
dialogues.text: There are no example problems left in the textbook.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あ、そう。じゃあ｛あくび／欠伸｝して暇そうにしている
　から特別問題だね♪」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, you're right. Well, you look so bored killing a yawn,
so I'll give a special problem for you."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, you're right. Well, you look so bored killing a yawn,
so I'll give a special problem for you."

dialogues.jp: カキカキ。
dialogues.en: Scratch, scratch, goes the chalk.
dialogues.text: Scratch, scratch, goes the chalk.

dialogues.jp: カキカキ。
dialogues.en: Scratch, scratch.
dialogues.text: Scratch, scratch.

dialogues.jp: カキカキ。
dialogues.en: Scratch, scratch.
dialogues.text: Scratch, scratch.

dialogues.jp: カキカキ。
dialogues.en: Scratch, scratch.
dialogues.text: Scratch, scratch.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あとは……っと」
dialogues.en: "Oookay..."
dialogues.text: "Oookay..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「いや……なんだそれ……宇宙から飛んできた
　電波でも受信してるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you picking up radio waves from space?"
dialogues.text: "Are you picking up radio waves from space?"

dialogues.jp:
すでに黒板の半分が、見知らぬ記号の羅列で埋
まっている。
dialogues.en:
The blackboard is already half filled with incomprehensible
symbols.
dialogues.text:
The blackboard is already half filled with incomprehensible
symbols.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「今だかつて誰も証明できなかった公式だから、
　できたらノーベル賞だよ〜♪」
dialogues.en:
"Nobody has solved this formula yet. If you can prove it,
you'll get the Novel Prize for sure."
dialogues.text:
"Nobody has solved this formula yet. If you can prove it,
you'll get the Novel Prize for sure."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……さくら先生、ちょっと」
dialogues.en: "Excuse me, Sakura-sensei."
dialogues.text: "Excuse me, Sakura-sensei."

dialogues.jp: にっこりと笑って、手招きする。
dialogues.en: I beckon her with a smile.
dialogues.text: I beckon her with a smile.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ、なになに♪」
dialogues.en: "Yes, what is it?"
dialogues.text: "Yes, what is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと後ろ向いて」
dialogues.en: "Can you turn around for a second?"
dialogues.text: "Can you turn around for a second?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あにゃ、なんかゴミとかついてる？」
dialogues.en: "Huuhh, is there anything on my back?"
dialogues.text: "Huuhh, is there anything on my back?"

dialogues.jp:
パタパタ、と軽い足音で近づいてきたさくらが、
回れ右をする。
dialogues.en: Sakura walks over me with noisy footsteps and turns around.
dialogues.text: Sakura walks over me with noisy footsteps and turns around.

dialogues.jp: 「やらせんなよそんな問題！！」
dialogues.en: "Don't give me shit like this!"
dialogues.text: "Don't give me shit like this!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Hmmm!!"
dialogues.text: "Hmmm!!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「はい撤収〜」
dialogues.en: "Okay, get out!"
dialogues.text: "Okay, get out!"

dialogues.jp: 半ばパターン化している、これが日常だった。
dialogues.en: This is the ordinary day we have at school.
dialogues.text: This is the ordinary day we have at school.

dialogues.jp: ◆さくら先生・ノーベル賞◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sakura-sensei Nobel Prize◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sakura-sensei Nobel Prize◆

dialogues.jp:
なにげない授業の最中、雑談していた杉並から、
さくらが体育会系のおっきいお兄ちゃん達に人
気があるなどと聞く。
dialogues.en:
Suginami told me that the boys on the varsity team like
Sakura.
dialogues.text:
Suginami told me that the boys on the varsity team like
Sakura.

dialogues.jp:
と、それが目についたのか、さくらから解けれ
ばノーベル賞モノの問題を出される俺だった。
dialogues.en:
In addition, Sakura set me a problem for the Nobel Prize, if
I can solve it.
dialogues.text:
In addition, Sakura set me a problem for the Nobel Prize, if
I can solve it.
